# @ndigo/view

Views, view targets, and content negotiation for Ndigo

Version-matched export index for the installed package. Read `README.md`
for usage; the workspace guide index ships with `@ndigo/cli` as
`assets/agent/docs-index.md`.

## Public exports

- `View` *(type)* — View for a web interaction. Implementations are responsible for rendering content, and exposing the model. A single view exposes multiple model attributes.
- `AbstractView` — Abstract base class for View implementations. Subclasses need to implement the actual rendering.
- `AbstractPathBasedView` — Abstract base class for path-based views.
- `AbstractTemplateView` — Abstract base class for template-based views.
- `RerouteView` — View that reroutes to an absolute, context relative, or current request relative route.
- `StringTemplateView` — Renders a simple string template into HTML by replacing \{\{variable\}\} placeholders.
- `ViewMapping` *(type)* — Resolves a route to the view target that should handle it.
- `AbstractViewMapping` — Base implementation for route-to-target mappings.
- `AbstractPathViewMapping` — Base implementation for mappings that resolve targets by path.
- `ViewResolver` *(type)* — Resolves a view name to a concrete View instance.
- `MAX_VIEW_CACHE_ENTRIES` — Upper bound on cached views. View names can be request-derived (default route names, path extensions), so an unbounded cache is a memory-growth vector; inserti…
- `BoundedCache`
- `createViewCacheKey` — Builds an unambiguous cache key for a view name/language pair.
- `AbstractCachingViewResolver` — AbstractCachingViewResolver.
- `isSafeViewName` — Returns whether a view name is safe to interpolate into a resolver path.
- `AbstractPathBasedViewResolver` — AbstractPathBasedViewResolver.
- `ImportViewResolver` — Resolves a view by importing the module at the resolved path.
- `NameViewResolver` — A simple implementation of ViewResolver that interprets a view name as a value in the current application context.
- `ViewResolverComposite` — A ViewResolver that delegates to others.
- `ViewTarget` *(type)* — Destination that receives rendered view output.
- `EventBridgeViewTarget` *(type)* — View target that forwards surface events back into the application layer.
- `likeViewTarget` — Tests whether a value behaves like a ViewTarget.
- `ViewTargetingContext` *(type)* — Everything a ViewTargeter may inspect to choose a destination.
- `ViewTargeter` *(type)* — Chooses the destination for one render pass.
- `ViewTargeterComposite` — Ordered targeter chain: the first non-`null` target wins and later targeters are not consulted.
- `FixedViewTargeter` — Always resolves to the same target.
- `RenderResult` *(type)* — A complete response document produced by a ProducerView.
- `ProducerView` *(type)* — A view that produces a complete response document rather than rendering into a "view-target".ViewTarget.
- `likeProducerView` — Returns whether a value behaves like a ProducerView.
- `AbstractSerializingView` — Abstract base for views that encode their model into a document body — the representation family served by content negotiation (JSON, CSV, text, bytes, …).
- `JSONView` — A platform-agnostic view that encodes its model as a JSON document.
- `A2UIView` — Serializes an array of A2UI messages (for example `createSurface` and `updateComponents`) as `application/a2ui+json`.
- `a2uiViewResolver` — Builds a resolver that serves A2UIView for one logical view name, so content negotiation can pick A2UI against other representations.
- `TextView` — A view that encodes its model as plain text (`text/plain`).
- `CSVViewOptions` *(type)* — Construction options for CSVView.
- `CSVView` — A view that encodes an array of record objects as a CSV document (`text/csv`), RFC 4180-style: a header row, `\r\n` row endings, and quoting of fields containi…
- `OctetStreamView` — A view that encodes its model as raw bytes (`application/octet-stream`) for downloads and binary payloads.
- `ContentNegotiationViewResolver`
- `MediaTypeFileExtensionResolver` *(type)*
- `ContentNegotiationStrategy` *(type)* — Resolves the media types supported for a request.
- `likeMediaTypeFileExtensionResolver` — Structural check for a `MediaTypeFileExtensionResolver`: accepts any value exposing both `getAllFileExtensions` and `resolveFileExtensions`, so a custom resolv…
- `MappingMediaTypeFileExtensionResolver`
- `FixedContentNegotiationStrategy`
- `canServeMediaType` — Whether a candidate media type can serve an accepted media range, honoring type/subtype inclusion and wildcard semantics. Single source of truth for the candid…
- `firstServableMediaType` — Returns the first candidate media type that can serve one of the accepted ranges, honoring the client's priority order (accepted ranges are already ordered by…
- `AbstractMappingContentNegotiationStrategy` — Base class for content negotiation strategies that also resolve file extensions.
- `PathExtensionContentNegotiationStrategy` — Content negotiation strategy that is intended to derive media types from the request path extension.
- `ContentNegotiationManager`
- `NotAcceptableError` — NotAcceptableError.
- `serializeModel` — Serializes a view model into a JSON string safe to embed in an HTML attribute.
- `parseModel` — Parses a serialized island model back into a JS value.
- `isValidCustomElementName` — Returns whether `name` is a valid, non-reserved custom-element tag name.
- `IslandView` — A server-rendered HTML view for partial hydration ("islands").
- `IslandViewOptions` *(type)* — Construction options for IslandView.
- `IslandViewResolverOptions` *(type)* — Configuration for IslandViewResolver.
- `IslandViewResolver` — Resolves view names to `IslandView` markers.
- `likeView` — Tests whether a value behaves like a View: an object exposing a `render` function and a `mediaType`.
